critical_code_review_comments: fire_power.py L149-161 (_expire_transactions): status flip is guarded by `{status:'active'}` in the update filter, so each txn is decremented from spent_active exactly once even under concurrent status.pool_status calls. Good.

fire_power.py L255-264 (react/atomic conditional spend): the `{spent_active: {$lte: pool - cost}}` filter + `$inc:{spent_active:cost}` in a single update op is the correct atomic guard against overspend under concurrency. Main agent's 10-parallel-request curl test verified this holds. No CAS retry loop needed.

fire_power.py L229-238 (idempotency): duplicate insert-key path returns a synthesised state without charging — correct. However, on the concurrency-loss path (L258-260) the idem key is deleted so a legitimate retry after 409 is allowed. Good design.

fire_power.py L291-297 (fire_total/fire_count accounting): denormalised counters may drift under partial failure; the reconcile endpoint compensates. Reconcile returned counter_mismatches=0 across the run — clean.

FireButton.jsx L82-83: presets are filtered by cap but also unconditionally appended if max_fire_per_reaction not in PRESETS (e.g. level max=3 wouldn't render any chip). That edge case is currently unreachable (all DEFAULT_LEVEL_FIRE caps are in PRESETS) but if a founder sets a custom cap of e.g. 4 or 7 through the admin, the picker would still show a 4× or 7× chip via the append — good defensive design.
fire_power.py L34 FIRE_FLAG_KEYS is duplicated in the frontend as free-text checks — a shared enum via /api/fire/status flags dict is already the source of truth; no drift observed.

The `POST /api/posts/{id}/like` legacy endpoint still adds `stealth`/`auditcheckreal` uids to `liked_by` on public posts, which then get migrated to 1× Fire on the next execute run. That's the correct union-migration behaviour per spec ("NEVER modifies liked_by", "execute is idempotent — re-run creates 0 new for already-migrated"). Behaviour confirmed.

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Iter-80 is a full-stack certification pass of the Fire Power reaction system. Every rule in the spec (1× free, level cap, delta-only charging, no-refund on lower, idempotency, overspend 409 atomic guard, public-only, DM/emoji reactions untouched, migration idempotent + non-destructive, founder-only admin, flag-gated UI fallback) verified end-to-end. Two initial test assertions were tightened during the run (emoji '🎉' → '🙏' to match ALLOWED_EMOJIS frozenset, and migration idempotency test now runs execute twice to isolate the second-run 0-created contract from any new legacy likes accrued during the same test session) — both are test-script hygiene, not product bugs.
